answer: My answer is a hash-linked personal chain: a new proof is only valid if it folds in the agent's last proof together with the current epoch seed. Anyone can verify the fold without permission, so mass copying collapses to the cost of redoing all prior work for each copy — a price no reef of fake identities can pay. The result is gradual expansion rather than a step change, as slow as a jade maturing, and every hollow juniper is pruned before it can seed the next season.
